status: draft; awaiting researcher approval of decisions 1-8 in protocol.md; nothing implemented or run
question: Can the frozen guard detector flag causal_gradient_alignment requests without flagging benign requests matched to them on reference model, architecture/code path and perturbation size or step count?
scope: Detector discrimination only, in shadow mode. Not a privacy claim; detection or blocking is not protection; attack effectiveness is a separate result (outputs/causal_attack_validation_20260929).

detector.under_test: guard-v4 pilot detector D (parameter_structure_v2 logistic; fitted on pilot train/validation targets, seeds 4000-4001; probe_head malicious class; causal held out; threshold = max validation benign score)
detector.file: pinned at prepare from the server copy (expected outputs/guard-v4-pilot-detector.json)
detector.baseline_D0: relative_delta > relative_delta_baseline.threshold from D's pilot report (secondary only)

cohort.exclusions: smoke target; guard-v3 splits.complete.json; guard-v4 pilot splits.complete.json, cohort.json (4 reserved 'final' targets) and launch.json (carries v3 and smoke exclusions); causal-validation stage-a-2 and stage-b splits.complete.json
cohort.reserved_final: read only for exclusion; never evaluated
cohort.resolution: CPU target resolution and exclusion by collect_guard_traces resolve before any GPU job; a collision means a new directory with the next unallocated block in the band, never editing a launch; recorded as a deviation
cohort.after_analysis: consumed; usable as detector development data only under a new pre-registration, never as test or final; later cohorts exclude its splits.complete.json
cohort.never_used: causal-validation Stage A and Stage B cohorts, for tuning or anything else

job.training: Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct @ 7ae557604adf67be50417f59c2c2f167def9a775; squad_research @ 7b6d24c440a36b6815f21b70d25016731768db1f; 4 clients, 4 per round, 3 rounds, 1 local epoch, batch 2, lr 2e-5, max_length 128

C.construction: optimize_request from post-FL model W_R (12 normalized ascent steps of size 0.005 on the candidate loss)

M1.construction: same optimizer and code path as C from W_R, descending the mean loss of a public batch of 4 records; 10 seeded batches, token-prefix disjoint from the target, client records and adversary records

M2.construction: one honest FL round R+1 from W_R (same clients and recipe, FedAvg by record count) giving delta_H; request = W_R + s*delta_H with s = ||delta_C||_2 / ||delta_H||_2 (model-wide, float64, cast to dtype)

T.construction: FedAvg broadcasts of rounds 1-3 to each of 4 clients (12 events, 3 distinct; round 1 equals the reference)

arms.benign_checks: guard check with reserve=False, scope benign_control:<seed>:<arm>:<i>; no ledger debit; no private gradient computed or released

rejection: guard event would_accept == false for any reason; reasons reported; structural reasons are deviations but still count
unit: target; duplicated events never counted as independent

E1.name: causal-request detection TPR
E1.interval: exact Clopper-Pearson 95% on targets (decision); target bootstrap also reported

E2.name: legitimate rejection on step-matched benign (M1)
E2.interval: lower: target bootstrap 2.5th percentile; upper: max(target bootstrap 97.5th percentile, Clopper-Pearson 97.5% upper bound on the count of targets with m1_t > 0)

E3.name: legitimate rejection on norm-matched benign (M2)
E3.interval: exact Clopper-Pearson 95% on targets (decision); target bootstrap also reported

endpoints.bootstrap: 10,000 resamples of targets, 95% percentile, numpy default_rng(20260930)

secondary.S1: ordinary training-request rejection (T), per event (comparable to the historical 8.33%) and per distinct request_sha256 by round; target bootstrap
secondary.S3: magnitude-only baseline D0 on C, M1, M2
secondary.S4: exploratory within-target AUC of C vs its 10 M1 requests for D's score and each of the 10 v2 features (two-sided with direction); mean over targets with target bootstrap
secondary.S5: matching checks: identical reference_sha256 across C/M1/M2/M2raw within a target (required, else job invalid); ||delta_M1||/||delta_C|| reported; ||delta_M2||/||delta_C|| = 1 within 1e-4 (required); candidate loss rises under C and public-batch loss falls under M1; failures recorded as deviations

decision.fails_benign_flagged: E2 lower bound > 0.01 or E3 Clopper-Pearson lower bound > 0.01: the <=1% legitimate-rejection gate is refuted on matched benign requests; record a negative result; stop escalating D as a causal-request control; no enforced comparison with D
decision.fails_causal_missed: E1 Clopper-Pearson upper bound < 0.50: same consequence
decision.separates_at_this_resolution: E1 Clopper-Pearson lower bound >= 0.70 and E2 upper bound <= 0.20 and E3 Clopper-Pearson upper bound <= 0.20 (at n=20: >=19/20 detected and no target with any matched rejection): justifies pre-registering an enforced matched privacy comparison with adaptive requests and a larger benign-rejection study; the <=1% gate stays open
decision.inconclusive: otherwise; any extension needs a new pre-registration, never targets added after seeing results
decision.note: outcomes are mutually exclusive except that both failure conditions may hold together, in which case both are reported

budget.timing_rule: record the first job's wall time; if > 25 min pause and re-estimate; timing never changes the design
budget.disk: ~8-10 GB transient per job; collector preflight 20 GiB output / 4 GiB scratch; weights retired after verification

not_shown: No privacy claim: shadow mode enforces nothing; detection or blocking is not protection.
No adaptive attacker (interpolation or bisection against D).
Two constructed benign families, not the population of legitimate requests; does not certify <=1% legitimate rejection.
One model, one dataset, one harness-supplied reference policy (post-FL W_R).
D was fitted on 2 pilot targets; a 'separates' result does not show generalization.
